runs.notes: Current Phase 7/9 structured JSON answer prompt. Note: v1 uses temperature=0.2, causing run-to-run variance. The phase-7 baseline run of the same prompt scored 0.829 answer accuracy vs 0.800 here; the difference is LLM non-determinism, not a code change. Subsequent prompt versions (v2 onward) use temperature=0.0 for reproducibility.
